thread:
marta: Quick flag — EmberHealth says their retainer auto-topup did not go through and their env is hitting rate limits. Invoice INV-2027-143 shows unpaid despite credit note.
billing-bot: [auto] payment attempt failed for INV-2027-143 amount $15,000. reason=ACH_DECLINED code=R01
sam: I'll pull the ledger and payment attempts now.
sam: ```sql
SELECT invoice, status, amount, credit_applied, note_id FROM finance_invoices WHERE invoice='INV-2027-143';
-- returns: INV-2027-143 | open | 15000 | false | CN-889 (orphaned)
```
jonah: Looks like CN-889 exists but the payment flow didn't attach it because the retainer_id on CN-889 is null. Probably a migration hiccup from last month's retainer rollout.
marta: Customer is urgent — can we apply the credit manually and retry charge? If we need to issue a reversal or provisional credit > $10k, I need an approval.
nina: Legal OK for provisional credit while we resolve root cause. Need an audit log entry and an approval message in this thread.
sara: I can approve up to $20k. Approving provisional application of CN-889 to INV-2027-143 so we can retry the ACH. Please document reason: "migration orphaned credit, customer-facing impact".
sam: Applying CN-889 to invoice and re-queuing charge now.
sam: ```
# commands
PATCH /internal/finance/credits/CN-889/apply { "invoice": "INV-2027-143" }
POST /internal/finance/charges/retry { "invoice": "INV-2027-143" }
```
sam: Charge retried — payment succeeded. payment_id=PAY-334455 settled_ts=1835879999
billing-bot: [auto] ledger update: INV-2027-143 status=paid settled_amount=$15000 settled_ts=1835879999 note=CN-889 applied
marta: :thumbsup: Thanks team. I'll update Zendesk #45678 and ping the customer that their service is restored. Jonah — can you open a small migration follow-up to prevent orphaned credits?
jonah: Yep, creating ticket INF-2027-92 with steps and a short rollout to backfill missing retainer_ids.
marta: Filing customer note and adding a copy of this thread to the audit record.
